name: ak:goal-warmup
overview: Outcome-locked preflight before long-running /goal or autonomous runs. Interview to a user-approved Outcome Contract, plan without silent scope drift, contract-preserving review, whole-plan preflight matrix, then Ready/Blocked/Decision handoff. Never auto-starts /goal. Use for goal warmup, goal prepare, long-running goal prep, outcome lock, execution readiness.
whenToUse: Invoke before expensive multi-phase /goal or long-run work when outcome must stay locked and blockers must surface first.

flags.name: --fast
flags.desc: skip adversarial reviewers; still run lightweight check that
